title: CAVIA shared context plus private residual rank sweep
hypothesis: A low-dimensional task-private residual on top of factorized shared CAVIA context recovers held-out interaction tasks with less actual payload than independent full contexts; residual rank traces the storage/quality break-even.
fit_policy: Fit shared factor context and residual basis using only the 12 training factor pairs. Fit held-out private residual codes only from that task's support examples. Audit samples never enter fitting.
storage: Actual serialized inference .npz bytes; charge shared predictor/basis, factor-angle context, residual basis, per-task residual codes, pair indices, schema and metadata.
compute: Report support-example count, least-squares evaluations, PCA fit cost proxy, active multiply-add proxy and wall time. Zero optimizer updates.
success_gate: Both dev seeds in private_interaction: held-out nRMSE <=0.05 and <=75% independent full-context payload at some rank; a Mirror-specific result also requires PCA residual to beat direct-coordinate residual at comparable bytes and compute.
failure_gate: No rank meets quality/storage, or native residual control matches PCA residual quality at equal/lower bytes and compute. Fresh seeds remain sealed on any gate miss.
boundaries: Task factor indices are known and charged
No natural task, meta-training, or language-model claim
Do not change rank, seeds or gates after development begins
